This notebook creates plots of relative biodiversity change at the local scale

```{r}
library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyterra)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(sf)
library(stringr)

setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path))
```

```{r}
# List all raster files in the project folder and subfolders
file_paths <- list.files(
   path = "../BES_results/",
   pattern = "\\.tif$",
   recursive = TRUE,
   full.names = TRUE,
   ignore.case = TRUE
)
file_paths
rasters <- rast(file_paths)
```

```{r}
# Extract just the filename without path or extension
file_names <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file_paths))
file_names
```

```{r}
names(rasters) <- file_names
names(rasters)
```

```{r}
# Convert to a long dataframe with x, y, layer name, and value
df <- as.data.frame(rasters, xy = TRUE)

# Reshape from wide (one column per layer) to long format
df_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  df,
  cols = -c(x, y),
  names_to = "layer",
  values_to = "value"
)

# Extract forest_type and scenario from the layer name
df_long <- df_long %>%
  mutate(
    forest_type = str_extract(layer, "nonforest|forest"),
    scenario    = str_extract(layer, "BAU|NaC|NfN|NfS")
  )

# Set factor order: forest_type controls columns, scenario controls rows
df_long$forest_type <- factor(df_long$forest_type, levels = c("forest", "nonforest"))
df_long$scenario <- factor(df_long$scenario, levels = c("NfN", "NaC", "NfS", "BAU"))
```


```{r}
table(df_long$forest_type, useNA = "ifany")
table(df_long$scenario, useNA = "ifany")
```

```{r}
# Get country/coastline boundaries
coastline <- ne_coastline(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")
coastline <- st_make_valid(coastline)
```

```{r}
# Shared continuous colour scale limits — same range used in every plot below
# so all panels and all figures remain directly comparable
value_limits <- range(df_long$value, na.rm = TRUE)
value_limits
```

# All scenarios × forest type — single faceted plot

```{r}
maps <- ggplot(df_long) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
  geom_sf(data = coastline, color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.1, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(scenario), cols = vars(forest_type)) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette  = "RdBu",
    direction = 1,
    limits   = value_limits,
    oob      = scales::squish,
    na.value = NA,
    name     = expression(Delta*"value")
  ) +
  coord_sf(expand = FALSE, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    legend.key.width   = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.key.height  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.text        = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.title       = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
  )

maps
```

```{r}
# How many NAs are in the value column?
sum(is.na(df_long$value))

# What's the actual range of non-NA values?
range(df_long$value, na.rm = TRUE)
```

# Pairwise comparison — one figure per scenario

```{r}
# Reusable function to make one scenario's forest vs nonforest plot
# Uses the same value_limits as the combined plot above, for comparability
make_scenario_plot <- function(scenario_code) {
  ggplot(df_long %>% filter(scenario == scenario_code)) +
    geom_tile(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = value)) +
    geom_sf(data = coastline, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.25, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    facet_wrap(~ forest_type, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_distiller(
      palette  = "RdYlBu",
      direction = 1,
      limits   = value_limits,
      oob      = scales::squish,
      na.value = NA,
      name     = expression(Delta*"value")
    ) +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE, xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position    = "bottom",
      legend.key.width   = unit(2, "cm"),
      legend.key.height  = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.text        = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.title       = element_text(size = 9),
      strip.text         = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold")
    ) +
    ggtitle(scenario_code)
}
```

```{r}
plot_NfN <- make_scenario_plot("NfN")
plot_NfN
plot_NaC <- make_scenario_plot("NaC")
plot_NaC
plot_NfS <- make_scenario_plot("NfS")
plot_NfS
plot_BAU <- make_scenario_plot("BAU")
plot_BAU
```
